name: headerpup
description: Browser extension (Firefox and Chrome) for quickly switching between request-header profiles.

scripts.build: npm run build:gecko && npm run build:webkit
scripts.lint:gecko: npm run build:gecko && web-ext lint --source-dir gecko/dist
scripts.run:gecko: npm run build:gecko && web-ext run --source-dir gecko/dist --start-url https://httpbin.org/headers
scripts.run:webkit: npm run build:webkit && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir webkit/dist --start-url https://httpbin.org/headers
scripts.package: npm run package:gecko && npm run package:webkit
scripts.package:gecko: npm run build:gecko && web-ext build --source-dir gecko/dist --artifacts-dir gecko/web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:webkit: npm run build:webkit && web-ext build --source-dir webkit/dist --artifacts-dir webkit/web-ext-artifacts --filename 'headerpup-{version}-chrome.zip' --overwrite-dest
